idea.title: Competitor price tracker — I check 6 sites manually every week, need automation

plan.tagline: Automate overdue invoice reminders for freelancers with zero setup.
plan.problem: Freelancers waste hours chasing late payments manually, losing revenue and productivity.
plan.solution: CLI tool that tracks invoices, sends automated polite reminders, and generates reports—all offline with optional email/SMS via system tools.
plan.target_market: Solo developers, designers, and small business owners who invoice clients globally and need a lightweight, no-frills solution.

build_phases.name: Core DB + add
build_phases.description: SQLite schema for invoices + CLI add/list commands

build_phases.name: Reports + alerts
build_phases.description: Generate overdue reports + system-level email/SMS reminders

build_phases.name: Demo + polish
build_phases.description: Hardcoded --demo mode + help text + edge case handling

plan.demo_script: Run `invoicechase --demo` to see 3 sample invoices, 1 overdue, with auto-generated reminder emails printed to console. No internet needed.
plan.phuket_angle: Perfect for Phuket-based digital nomads and small businesses (e.g., dive shops, tour operators) who invoice international clients and need a simple, offline-capable tool to chase payments without relying on unstable Thai internet.
